{title} {subtitle}

{t('totp.title', 'Two-factor authentication')}
{t( 'totp.openMode.message', 'Per-user TOTP requires forward-auth mode. Configure your reverse proxy to inject X-Forwarded-User then reload.', )} ) } export default TotpOpenModeNotice

/** * Hero status panel — the primary surface of the two-factor page. * * Pure presentation: it reflects the current credential state and * forwards user intent (enroll / regenerate / disable) to callbacks * owned by `useTotpEnrollmentFlow`. Preserves the original * `data-testid` hooks so the section contract test is unaffected. */ import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next' import { ShieldCheck, KeyRound, RefreshCw, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react' import { GlassPanel, IconBox, Button, Badge, Heading, Text, HelperText } from '@/components/ui' import { useDateFormat } from '@/hooks/useDateFormat' import { knownNumber } from '@/api/dataState' interface TotpStatusHeroProps { activated: boolean lastUsedAt?: string backupRemaining: number | null | undefined enrolling: boolean regenerating: boolean onEnroll: () => void onRegenerate: () => void onDisable: () => void } export function TotpStatusHero({ activated, lastUsedAt, backupRemaining, enrolling, regenerating, onEnroll, onRegenerate, onDisable, }: TotpStatusHeroProps) { const { t } = useTranslation('settings') const { formatDateTime } = useDateFormat() const knownBackupRemaining = knownNumber(backupRemaining) const safeBackupRemaining = knownBackupRemaining != null && Number.isSafeInteger(knownBackupRemaining) && knownBackupRemaining >= 0 ? knownBackupRemaining : t('common.dash', '—') const hasLastUsed = typeof lastUsedAt === 'string' && lastUsedAt.trim().length > 0 && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(lastUsedAt)) return (
{t('totp.title', 'Two-factor authentication')} {t( 'totp.subtitle', 'TOTP codes from your authenticator app are required for the sudo step-up before destructive admin actions.', )}
{activated ? t('totp.status.active', 'Active') : t('totp.status.notEnrolled', 'Not enrolled')}
{activated ? (
{t('totp.lastUsed.label', 'Last used')} {hasLastUsed ? formatDateTime(lastUsedAt) : t('common.dash', '—')}
{t('totp.backupCodesRemaining.label', 'Backup codes remaining')} {safeBackupRemaining}
) : (
{t( 'totp.actions.enrollHint', 'Compatible with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Bitwarden, Authy and other RFC 6238 clients.', )}
)} ) } export default TotpStatusHero
